title: Gurkha
desc: A group of ex-army officials takes innocent people at a shopping centre hostage. When a security guard of Gurkha descent learns that the captives include the woman he loves, he sets out to save them.

title: Malikappuram
desc: A young aspiring film director who seeks to make his directorial debut decides to use a real-life gangster as inspiration for his first movie.

title: Viruman
desc: Viruman is a young man who watches his mother immolate herself. As a result, he distances himself from his father and vows to avenge her death.

title: Manithan
desc: In order to earn quick money and fame, a struggling lawyer accepts a bribe and joins hands with a man who pretends to be a witness in a case. However, his conscience forces him to fight for justice.

title: Silukkuvarpatti Singam
desc: Police constable Shakthi prefers a laid back approach to his job and tries to actively stay away from danger. But he is forced to change this attitude when he inadvertently jails a wanted don.

title: Bruce Lee 2 the Fighter
desc: Kartik sacrifices his studies for his sister and becomes a stuntman. But he ends up helping a cop to unearth the evil designs of Deepak.
